scope: Full AO/fitting domains, fixed pairs and PNO/TNO ranks. Other screened-energy corrections are verified zero.
notes: Every ordered entry is computed independently; neither matrix is symmetrized or projected.
The geometry is nonstationary; the rotational check is H(Omega R)=Omega g.
Finite-space cutoffs: first PNO 1e-5, final PNO 1e-4, TNO 1e-5. Full-space cutoffs are zero.
Hessian units are hartree/bohr^2, gradients hartree/bohr, positions bohr.
